observations.body: After a vineyard parable, Jesus speaks of the Kingdom being taken and given to a people producing its fruit.
observations.label: The Kingdom and its fruit

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside the kingdom and its fruit.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 21:41–45 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states after a vineyard parable, Jesus speaks of the Kingdom being taken and given to a people producing its fruit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
